Metadata.title: Lango: Tanzanian government services in one place
Metadata.description: Ask in English or Swahili, or tap a service: NIDA, passport, TIN, BRELA, RITA, driving licence, NHIF, NSSF, HESLB, NECTA, LUKU and more. Steps, verified fees and the official link.

Hero.title: Hello, Tanzania
Hero.subtitle: Whatever you need from government, start here.

Search.label: Ask a question or type a service
Search.placeholder: E.g. I want to get a NIDA ID
examples: I want to get a NIDA ID

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The link may have changed or no longer exists.

Footer.disclaimer: Lango is an independent guide, not a government website. Check every step on the agency's site before paying or submitting.
Footer.privacy: Your step progress is stored on your device only.

Ask.aiNote: The assistant only answers from Lango's verified data. Check the official site.
Ask.aiIntro: AI helps you find the right service. Every step, fee and link comes from official sources we have checked.

Home.topicsLede: Every guide lists the documents to prepare, the steps to follow, verified fees and the link to the official site.
Home.agenciesBody: No more wandering from site to site. Lango brings the steps for government services together in one place.
Home.privacyBody: We never ask for your NIN, phone number or password. Personal details are removed from your question before it reaches the assistant, and the steps you tick off stay on your device.
Home.sourcesBody: Every step, fee and link comes from the agency's own official website, with the date we last checked it.
Home.appBody: Just open Lango in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer.

Guide.stepsHint: Tick each step when you finish it. Saved on your phone only.

Services.title: All services
Services.lede: Verified guides from official government websites.

Banner.text: An independent guide to Tanzanian government services. Not a government website.
Banner.linksTitle: We only send you to the agency's own site
Banner.linksBody: Every official link on Lango shows the site address (e.g. nida.go.tz). Check that your browser shows the same address before you enter any details.
Banner.privacyTitle: We never ask for your personal details
Banner.privacyBody: Lango will never ask for your NIN, phone number or password. Applications and payments happen on the official site only.
